scope: Twelfth noncanonical/unapplied owner-internal atomic explicit result, exact new summary job and retained-capacity queue transfer. No endpoint/worker wiring, ordinary execution, provider IO, finish/settlement or held release.
source_and_capability: Require the actual immutable pending receipt and original actor/operation capability; revalidate current edit/view/non-partner access, exact registered source/origin completion, object/version/hash/size/type/pending revision, active rescan lease and both units using the verified eleventh-stage helper before mutation.
normalized_input: Only seven projected fields: ok, code, provider, scan_id, clean_result, threats, blocked_reasons. Do not forward the complete scanner result, error_message or provider body. Explicit clean requires true/clean/true with empty threats and blocks; explicit infection requires false/infected/false and nonempty bounded threat names. All other/unknown/malformed/contradictory fields refuse without terminal writes.
atomicity: Change only scan/result/review/quarantine fields and canonical revision. Validate actual returned source and receipt; record immutable metadata, selected new UUID job and same-transaction witness. The job FK and constraint trigger defer until commit, while explicit validation before RPC return confirms exact queued row, actor/student/source, unclaimed status, and the reservation pointer. Missing/skipped/altered writes roll back the entire handoff.
same_transaction_edit_fence: A SHA-256 of the complete JSONB document snapshot detects later same-transaction edits even though canonical now() can preserve updated_at. Only that digest is retained privately, not title/text/summary copies. This is a commit-time metadata snapshot witness, not permanent source identity, physical bytes or future worker-completion proof.
historical_summaries: Prior completed summaries remain permitted and frozen. New INSERT and source-retarget UPDATE paths serialize with the same capacity/completion mutex and require the exact selected same-transaction queue row for tracked rescans. No new queue can slip into pending/quarantine or adopt an unrelated job. This does not prove coverage of all legacy/nontracked writers or provider drain.
capacity: Retain both units after either result. Clean binds one exact new summary job to the already reserved slot without adding units. Existing guarded queue transfer UPDATE uses the completion fence so prior admitted work can drain while paused; fresh reservation INSERT retains the original admission/policy checks. No expiry, reset, deletion, completion or release path.
ownership: Exact prerequisite hashes, owners, fixed paths and private grants required. Existing owners/grants preserved; new functions/table owned by migration executor and ordinary/service execution/raw/column access revoked. No owner/role-attribute transfer.
retention: Private immutable operation/actor/document/revision/hash/snapshot digest/disposition/local-scan-correlation/time/counts/job metadata only. No capability, names, document text or provider body. Public document verdict retains normalized threat names and worker-compatible source=registration_reviewed_copy plus rescan_reviewed_copy=true.
physical_provider_boundary: The normalized result is supplied only by a future trusted same-Blob adapter. Neither echoed content hash, local scan UUID, snapshot digest, timestamp nor database receipt proves physical Storage bytes, vendor job identity, cancellation, provider completion/drain or retry billing.

local_model_partitions.filter: include producer prefixes, explicitly exclude rescan outcome

required_next: Prepare source-bound rescan completion and conservative settlement: producer one only after exact clean/queue proof; both rescan units only after confirmed no-new-summary quarantine. Keep held/uncertain provider work counted.

Wire exact claim -> same copy -> committed pending -> dispatch -> projected result protocol and separately identified worker only after transaction-held authority, shared source/capacity hooks, legacy/direct writers, trusted reconciliation and physical/provider gates are resolved.
Complete Apply and canonical/ledger packaging, then seek fresh specific authorization for coordinated hosted staging rollout/acceptance.

completion_followup_review.status: Reviewed follow-up contract; twelfth-stage native/full-schema verification complete. Completion/settlement remains unimplemented.
rules: The twelfth-stage validate_internal_document_rescan_outcome is a same-transaction commit validator. Do not reuse it as a later finish/settlement reader: outcome_txid must differ in later transactions, and a legitimate worker can update derived document fields after the producer handoff commits.

Keep the immutable original rescan outcome/selected-job/source binding as producer evidence. A future completion reader must verify its exact operation/actor/source and current permitted source/access separately; do not mistake a legitimate source-bound summary commit for a rescan source switch merely because the complete metadata snapshot or updated_at changed.

Test producer completion both before and after the exact worker claim, worker output commit and guarded summary completion. Follow the exact counted job/summary-operation/source bindings; never adopt an unrelated or untracked processing/completed status.

Producer clean completion may release only its one producer unit after exact persisted clean-plus-selected-queue proof. The existing eighth-stage summary settlement already permits register/rescan reservations, but releases its own one unit only after the actual guarded summary completion receipt and exact source/result/job/operation proof. Account for both settlement orders without subtraction twice or releasing the other obligation.

Confirmed quarantine may release two rescan units only with the exact immutable no-new-summary outcome and no linked/unresolved summary work. Completed historical summaries stay allowed/frozen; a generic all-history prohibition is wrong.

Keep typed rescan completion blocked until the reviewed source-bound completion recorder/guard exists. Preserve the existing finish owner, private admission lease ownership and ordinary grants; use the narrow reviewed owner-context bridge if finish must call a new private recorder.

Missing/foreign/lost receipts, unknown queue/worker states, changed source/access, held leases and provider uncertainty stay counted and require trusted reconciliation. Neither local scan correlation, snapshot digest, clock nor a completed status substitutes for that evidence.
